blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Person re-identification (ReID) ranks an image gallery using either an image query or a textual query. In image-to-image (I2I) ReID, viewpoint, illumination, occlusion, and background changes can make distractors appear more similar than the true match. In text-to-image (T2I) ReID, incomplete or ambiguous descriptions may omit key visual evidence. We study this problem for vision-language model (VLM) based ReID, where attributes such as clothing color and carried objects provide useful fine-grained matching cues. However, directly using attribute-prompt similarities as retrieval scores is unreliable because templated prompts can be biased, correlated, and poorly calibrated. We therefore propose \textbf{PR}ompt-guided \textbf{A}ttribute-based \textbf{I}nference-time \textbf{S}imilarity \textbf{E}nhancement (\texttt{PRAISE}), a query-side test-time adaptation framework for VLM-based ReID. Instead of treating prompts as scores, \texttt{PRAISE} uses a transferable attribute-prompt bank to construct an \emph{Attribute-Conditioned Subspace} (ACS): a query-dependent low-rank subspace induced by the most compatible attribute prompts. ACS provides a controlled attribute-conditioned geometry for reshaping query--gallery affinities and guiding lightweight inference-time updates without identity or attribute labels. Experiments across multiple I2I- and T2I-ReID benchmarks show that \texttt{PRAISE} consistently improves VLM retrieval backbones and outperforms both generic and ReID-specific TTA baselines.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve images of the same identity across cameras and time. It is commonly studied in two retrieval settings: image-to-image (I2I) ReID, where an image query is matched against an image gallery, and text-to-image (T2I) ReID, where a natural-language description is used to retrieve the corresponding person image. Despite steady progress in both settings using image and text supervision [ 26 , 55 ] , test-time retrieval remains sensitive to nuisance factors. In I2I-ReID, viewpoint changes, pose variation, blur, illumination, occlusion, and background clutter can make visually plausible distractors outrank the true match [ 38 ] . In T2I-ReID, retrieval can fail for a complementary reason: natural-language descriptions are often incomplete, ambiguous, or noisy, and may omit discriminative visual evidence [ qin2024noisy ] . Thus, although the query modality differs, both settings suffer from insufficiently reliable query-gallery evidence at test time.
blocks.zh: 人物再识别(ReID)旨在跨相机和时间取回同一身份的相片. 通常在两个检索设置中研究:图像对映(I2I)ReID,一个图像查询与图像相匹配;文本对映(T2I)ReID,一个自然语言描述用于取回相应的人物图像. 尽管在使用图像和文本监督的两种设置中都取得了稳步进展[26,55],但测试时间检索仍然对麻烦因素很敏感. 在I2I-ReID中,视角变化,呈现出变化,模糊,发光,被隐蔽,以及背景杂乱,可以使视觉上可信的分心器排出真正的对等 [38]. 在T2I-ReID中,检索可能因为一个互补的原因而失败:自然语言描述往往不完整,模棱两可,或吵闹,可能忽略了歧视性视觉证据[qin2024noisy]. 因此,尽管查询方式不同,但两种设置在测试时都存在不够可靠的查询采集证据.

blocks.en: A natural way to strengthen this evidence is to use semantic attributes as an auxiliary matching signal. If a query and a gallery image depict the same identity, their match should be supported not only by raw embedding similarity, but also by agreement over stable person-centric cues such as clothing color, clothing type, carried objects, hair, or accessories. Conversely, if two samples correspond to different identities, at least some of these cues are likely to disagree. We refer to such cues as attributes : attributes that are visually observable, likely to remain meaningful across camera views, and expressible in both image and text queries. These attributes are not intended to uniquely identify a person, but they can provide useful corrective evidence for rejecting implausible matches and reinforcing plausible ones.
blocks.zh: 强化这种证据的自然方式是使用语义属性作为辅助匹配信号. 如果一个查询和一个画廊图像描绘了相同的身份,那么他们的匹配不仅应该通过原始嵌入相似性来支持,而且还应该通过对稳定的以人为中心的提示,如服装颜色,服装类型,被携带的物品,发型,或附件的约定来支持. 反之,如果两个样本对应不同身份,至少其中部分提示可能不同意. 我们把这样的提示称为属性:可视化的属性,在相机视图中可能保持有意义的属性,在图像和文本查询中都能够表达出来. 这些属性并不是为了唯一地识别一个人,但可以提供有用的纠正证据来拒绝不可信的匹配并强化可信的匹配.

blocks.en:
Attribute-based cues have been widely explored in person retrieval, including attribute-based ReID and text-based person search [ 42 , 49 , 12 , 5 ] . Prior methods typically use attributes as predicted labels, auxiliary supervision, or learned cross-modal embeddings, relying on training or fine-tuning to calibrate visual evidence with attribute semantics.
In contrast, our work considers a more realistic setting in which no target-domain identity labels or attribute annotations are available, and no additional attribute classifier can be trained. Under these constraints, we construct a transferable bank of attributes that capture visually observable, person-centric cues, such as clothing color and type, hair, and accessories, that remain stable across camera views and can be consistently expressed in both image and text queries.
VLMs [ 26 , 14 , 55 ] can encode these cues as natural-language prompts, allowing textual semantics to be reused in I2I-ReID, where the text branch is typically discarded at inference [ 26 ] , while naturally supporting T2I-ReID. A simple approach is to compare query and gallery responses to this prompt bank and fuse the resulting attribute similarity with identity affinity. However, we show that this direct fusion is unreliable because attribute prompts are coarse, shared across identities, correlated in VLM text space, and biased by prompt templates. Consequently, raw attribute scores are often poorly calibrated and can amplify generic distractors instead of improving retrieval.
blocks.zh:
在个人检索中广泛探索了基于属性的提示,包括基于属性的ReID和基于文本的人搜索[42,49,12,5]. 先前的方法通常使用属性作为预测的标签,辅助监督,或者学习到的跨模式嵌入,依靠训练或微调来用属性语义来校正视觉证据.
相形之下,我们的工作认为一个更现实的设置,在这种设置中,没有目标域身份标签或属性说明,无法训练出额外的属性分类器. 在这些限制下,我们构建了一个可转移的属性库,能够捕捉可视、以人为中心的提示,例如服装颜色和类型、发型和附件,这些特征在相机视图之间保持稳定,并能在图像和文本查询中一致表达。
VLMs [26, 14, 55] 可将这些提示编码为自然语言的提示,允许文本语义在 I2I-ReID 中被再用,其中文本分支在推论中通常被丢弃 [26],同时自然支持 T2I-ReID. 一种简单的做法是比较对这个快取银行的查询和图片库的答复,并将由此产生的属性与身份亲和性相类似。 然而,我们表明,这种直接核聚变是不可靠的,因为属性提示很粗糙,在身份之间共享,在VLM文本空间中相互关联,并且被即时模板所偏向. 因此,原始属性分数的校正往往很差,可以扩大通用分取器,而不是改进检索。

blocks.en: This motivates a different test-time use of attributes. Instead of acting as direct matching scores, prompts should guide the adaptation geometry itself. To this end, we propose PRAISE : PR ompt-guided A ttribute-based I nference-time S imilarity E nhancement. For each query, PRAISE selects the most compatible attribute prompts and orthogonalizes their directions to form an Attribute-Conditioned Subspace (ACS). Query-gallery comparisons are then reshaped within this low-rank, query-conditioned subspace, allowing attributes to provide structured auxiliary evidence without relying on brittle prompt-profile matching. The resulting ACS affinity is combined with the standard identity affinity and used to drive a lightweight test-time adaptation objective that updates only normalization parameters. We assume a transductive retrieval setting where the gallery is available at test time, following prior works [ adachi2024test , wang2020tent ] . The same mechanism applies to both I2I-ReID and T2I-ReID, differing only in whether the query representation is produced by the visual or text encoder.
blocks.zh: 这激发了对属性的不同测试时间使用. 提示不应作为直接匹配分数,而应指导适应几何本身。 为此,我们提议PRAISE: PR ompt-guided A 属性基 I 推论-time S milary E nhancement. 对于每个查询,PRAISE会选择最相容的属性提示并正向化其方向来组成一个属性条件子空间(ACS). 然后在这个低等,有查询条件的子空间内重塑查询-采集比较,使属性可以提供结构化的辅助证据而无需依赖Brittle即时相配. 由此产生的ACS亲和性与标准身份亲和性结合,并用于驱动一个只更新正常化参数的轻量级测试-时间适应目标. 我们假设一个转录检索设置,在测试时间,在以前的作品[achi2024test., wang2020tent.]之后,可以提供画廊。 同一机制既适用于I2I-ReID,也适用于T2I-ReID,仅在查询表示是由视觉编码器还是文本编码器生成方面有所不同.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: (1) PRAISE , a test-time adaptation method for ReID that improves query-gallery ranking by combining identity affinity with prompt-guided attribute evidence while updating only lightweight normalization parameters. (2) The Attribute-Conditioned Subspace (ACS), a test-time-compatible mechanism that uses attribute prompts as query-conditioned geometric directions rather than direct matching scores, mitigating prompt-similarity bias during retrieval. (3) A label-free, transferable attribute prompt-bank construction protocol for ReID. The bank captures stable person-centric cues, is pre-encoded once, requires no target-domain identity or attribute labels, and supports both I2I and T2I retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:(1) PRAISE,一种用于ReID的测试时间适应方法,它通过将身份亲和度与即时制导属性证据相结合,同时仅更新轻量级正常化参数来改进查询-采集排名。 (2)属性条件子空间(ACS),是一种测试时间相容的机制,它使用属性提示作为查询条件几何方向,而不是直接匹配分数,减轻检索过程中的即时-同位异位偏差. (3)ReID的无标签可转让属性即时-银行建设协议. 银行捕捉到稳定的以人为中心的提示,被预编码一次,不需要目标域身份或属性标签,并支持I2I和T2I的检索.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Image-to-Image (I2I) Re-identification. I2I-ReID methods were developed as the principal form of Re-identification in different scenarios such as ordinary/traditional ReID [ 8 , 16 , 48 , 37 ] , clothes-changing ReID [ 23 , 24 , 6 , 11 ] , Visual Infrared-ReID [ 41 , 18 , 51 , 50 , 54 , 32 ] for low lighting conditions, etc. Recently, models such as CLIP-ReID [ 26 ] have emerged, which use the superior representation power of VLMs in order to perform Re-identification. General-purpose models such as PLIP [ 55 ] have also been proposed, which are essentially VLMs intended for use in ReID settings for both I2I and T2I (Text-to-image) ReID. However, existing VLM-based ReID methods largely underutilize multimodal alignment by relying on cosine similarity between visual embeddings. We argue that this image-only approach overlooks the text branch as a stable semantic prior for mitigating domain shifts, such as camera bias, pose variation [ 38 ] , and visual noise.

blocks.en: Test-time Adaptation of VLMs. Several methods have been proposed to adapt VLMs to unseen data streams. CLIPArTT [ 7 ] introduces a cross-modal pseudo-labeling loss that refines image-wise prompts, while WATT [ 30 ] utilizes prompt ensembling to stabilize retrieval. However, these loss functions often remain heuristically decoupled from the original contrastive geometry of the backbone. Alternative paradigms, such as TPT [ 36 ] , employ prompt tuning to optimize context tokens at test time, but reliance on multiple stochastic augmentations introduces significant computational overhead. Gradient-free alternatives like TDA [ 17 ] utilize cache-based pseudo-labeling to simulate few-shot episodes, yet struggle under severe out-of-distribution shifts where the cached support becomes unreliable. In contrast to classification-centric TTA methods, we propose PRAISE , which modulates adaptation geometry through an attribute-conditioned subspace. By updating only a small set of normalization parameters, PRAISE enables robust open-set adaptation without unstable global updates or costly augmentation-based tuning.
blocks.zh: 测试时间 适应VLM. 已经提出了几种方法,使虚拟LM适应看不见的数据流。 CLIPARTT [7] 引入了跨模式的伪标签损失,精炼出以图像为导向的提示,而WATT [30] 则利用即时综艺来稳定检索. 然而,这些损失功能往往与骨干原有的对比几何相去甚远。 替代范式,如TPT [36],在测试时采用即时调制来优化上下文符号,但依赖多条分形的增强引入了重大的计算间接费用. 如TDA[17]等无渐变的替代品利用缓存制成的伪标签来模拟几发镜头,然而在被缓存支持变得不可靠的情况下,在严重的分流外转移下挣扎. 与以分类为中心的TTA方法形成对比的是,我们提出PRAISE ,它通过属性条件的子空间来调节适应几何. PRAISE仅更新了一小组正常化参数,就能够进行强力的开放式适应,而无需不稳定的全球更新或昂贵的基于增强的调试。

blocks.en: Text-to-Image (T2I) Re-identification. Existing T2I-ReID methods [ 4 , 13 , qin2024noisy , 39 , 53 , 44 , 46 ] predominantly follow a tripartite taxonomy based on architectural design: (i) unimodal alignment via modality-specific encoders (e.g., ResNet [ 9 ] , BERT [ 43 ] ), (ii) zero-shot retrieval using general-purpose vision-language models like CLIP [ 35 ] , and (iii) domain-specific multimodal pre-training tailored for ReID. While recent advancements in cross-modal embedding models have bridged the high-level semantic gap, these offline frameworks remain constrained by a static internal knowledge base, making them brittle against dynamic or underspecified text queries during inference. Recent literature has explored interactive paradigms, such as THI [ 34 ] , which utilizes multi-round visual question answering with MLLMs to refine query intent. However, these methods often incur high computational cost and suffer from label leakage or error accumulation. In contrast, PRAISE uses an attribute-conditioned subspace (ACS), aligning visual features with textual prompts via lightweight normalization updates. This enables efficient open-set adaptation without multi-round refinement.
blocks.zh: 文本对图像(T2I)再识别. 现有的T2I-ReID方法[4,13,qin2024noisy,39,53,44,46]主要遵循基于建筑设计的三方分类法:(一)通过特定模式编码器(如ResNet [9],BERT [43]),(二)使用CLIP [35]等通用视觉语言模型进行零镜头取回,(三)为ReID定制的专用领域多模式预训. 虽然最近在跨模式嵌入模式上取得的进展已弥补了高级语义差距,但这些离线框架仍然受到一个静态内部知识库的制约,使其在推论期间难以应对动态或不明确的文本查询。 近代文献探索了互动范式,例如THI [34],利用多轮视觉问题回答MLLMs来完善查询意图. 然而,这些方法往往需要高昂的计算成本,并受到标签漏出或误差累积的影响。 相形之下,PRAISE使用一个属性条件化的子空间(ACS),通过轻量级正常化更新,将视觉特征与文字提示相配合. 这使得在不进行多轮改进的情况下能够有效地进行开放式适应。

blocks.en: 3.1 Attribute Scores as Corrective Retrieval Signal

blocks.en: A natural way to improve retrieval robustness is to introduce semantic attributes as an additional source of evidence. Attributes such as clothing color, sleeve length, lower-body clothing type, gender, hair, carried objects, and accessories are not sufficient to uniquely identify a person, but they often provide useful constraints on whether a query-gallery pair is plausible. Following this intuition, an established design pattern is score fusion [ 1 , 21 ] . The retrieval system computes two affinities for each query-gallery pair: an identity or appearance affinity 𝐀 id \mathbf{A}_{\text{id}} , and an attribute-based affinity 𝐀 att \mathbf{A}_{\text{att}} . The final matching score is then formed as a weighted combination: 𝐀 ⁡ [ i , j ] = 𝐀 id ​ [ i , j ] + λ att ​ 𝐀 att ​ [ i , j ] , \mathbf{A}[i,j]=\mathbf{A}_{\text{id}}[i,j]+\lambda_{\mathrm{att}}\mathbf{A}_{\text{att}}[i,j], (2) where λ att ≥ 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{att}}\geq 0 controls the contribution of the attribute branch. Conceptually, 𝐀 id \mathbf{A}_{\text{id}} captures the raw embedding-level similarity between the query and gallery image, while 𝐀 att \mathbf{A}_{\text{att}} acts as a corrective semantic score. The identity score can come from an existing ReID backbone, while the attribute score can be computed using an auxiliary attribute classifier, a text-attribute model, or a VLM prompt bank. A high attribute score should promote candidates that share query-consistent semantic evidence, while a low attribute score should suppress candidates whose appearance similarity is likely caused by nuisance correlations.

blocks.en: 4 Attribute conditioned subspace construction and PRAISE
blocks.zh: 4 附带条件的子空间构建和PRAISE

blocks.en: Given a frozen VLM and a target-domain test set (queries and gallery), we propose PRAISE , a TTA method that leverages noisy natural-language attribute prompts to recalibrate the embedding space under domain shift to improve query-gallery ranking for both I2I-ReID and T2I-ReID. PRAISE is a TTA method that performs the following key steps: (1) precompute a bank of attribute prompt embeddings, (2) construct a query-conditioned attribute subspace using the prompt bank, and (3) adapt a small subset of backbone parameters at test time, to improve retrieval performance. Please refer to Figure 3 for an overview of the methodology.

blocks.en: We now define the attribute-conditioned subspace (ACS) that will be used by PRAISE . For a given query, ACS is a low-rank, query-conditioned subspace spanned by the text directions of the most compatible attribute prompts. Rather than treating prompt similarities as final matching scores, ACS uses prompts to identify a small set of semantic directions along which query-gallery comparisons can be made more reliably. Thus, the prompt bank acts as the source of candidate attribute directions from which the query-specific subspace is constructed.
blocks.zh: 我们现在定义了PRAISE将使用的属性条件子空间。 对于给定的查询,ACS是一个低等的,有查询条件的子空间,由最相容的属性提示的文本方向所覆盖. ACS没有将即时相似性作为最终匹配分数处理,而是使用快取来识别一小组语义取向,沿此可进行更可靠的查询-采集比较. 因此,即时银行作为候选属性方向的来源,用来构建特定查询子空间.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate PRAISE in two different settings: Image-to-Image (I2I) ReID and Text-to-Image (T2I) ReID. We use MSMT17 [ 45 ] and Market-1501 [ 52 ] for I2I, and CUHK-PEDES [ 25 ] and RSTP-ReID [ 53 ] for T2I. At test time, all methods are given (i) the query (image or text) and (ii) the unlabeled target gallery. We pre-encode all gallery features once and reuse them for all methods for efficiency. Furthermore, we ensure that all methods are granted the same access to unlabeled gallery features under the same episodic/reset protocol as our approach. All runtimes are measured on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU (single GPU) with identical implementation settings (batch size, mixed precision), and exclude the one-time cost of gallery feature pre-encoding. Adam optimizer has been used throughout, for all experiments.

blocks.en: How does PRAISE perform on I2I-ReID? A consistent trend is that classifier-oriented TTA methods often degrade performance compared to no-adapt (e.g., TENT/SHOT/SAR/ETA) [ wang2020tent , 27 , 29 , 28 ] , with only minor gains from DeYO [ 20 ] . VLM-based TTA methods [ 36 , 17 ] are more stable, while the strongest baselines are ReID-specific methods such as TEMP [ adachi2024test ] and Norm [ 38 ] . We find that direct score fusion has some limited semantic improvement but the poor calibration leads to a poorer Rank-1. PRAISE substantially improves mAP over all baselines and also yields consistent Rank-1 gains. Although TDA and Norm are faster because they are backpropagation-free, PRAISE provides a strong runtime-accuracy tradeoff. Moreover, since Norm is post-hoc, it can be applied on top of PRAISE with only a 0.3ms/sample overhead, further improving performance.
blocks.zh: PRAISE在I2I-ReID上表现如何?. 一个一致的趋势是,与不适应性相比,面向分级的TTA方法往往会降解性能(如:TENT/SHOT/SAR/ETA)[wang2020tent. 27,29,28],从DeYO[20]中只获得微小收益. VLM-基于TTA的方法[36,17]较为稳定,而最强的基线是REID专用方法,如TEMP[adach2024test]和Norm [38]. 我们发现,直接分数聚变 有一些有限的语义改进 但差的校正 导致更贫穷的一等分。 PRAISE大大改进了所有基线的mAP,并取得了一致的Rank-1收益。 虽然TDA和Norm因为无反向传播而更快,但PRAISE提供了很强的跑时精确取舍. 此外,由于诺姆是后荷克,它可以被应用到PRAISE上方,只有0.3ms/sample的间接费用,进一步提高了性能.

blocks.en: How does PRAISE perform on T2I-ReID? A similar trend holds for T2I-ReID: classifier-logit methods such as TENT and SHOT [ wang2020tent , 27 ] give only marginal gains, while VLM classification-based methods such as TPT, TDA, WATT, CLIPArTT and CLIPTTA [ 36 , 17 , 30 , 7 , 19 ] are often unstable and can degrade retrieval. TCR [ 22 ] is the strongest retrieval-specific baseline, but PRAISE achieves the best results on both datasets, improving CUHK-Pedes from 47.6/57.0 to 49.6/58.4 and RSTPReID from 25.8/36.6 to 27.6/37.6 in mAP/R1. Although slower than no-adapt and TCR, PRAISE remains much faster than augmentation-heavy methods such as TPT and WATT, while providing stronger retrieval accuracy under incomplete or ambiguous text queries. Similar to I2I-ReID, we find direct score fusion has a positive effect on the overall retrieval but leads to the ranking accuracy going down due to its improper calibration.
blocks.zh: PRAISE在T2I-ReID上的表现如何?. T2I-ReID也有类似的趋势:分类器-记录方法如TENT和SHOT[wang2020tent.,27]只给予边际收益,而VLM分类方法如TPT,TDA,WATT,CLIPARTT和CLIPTA[36,17,30,7,19]往往不稳定并可以降解检索. TCR [22]是最强的检索特定基准,但PRAISE在两个数据集上都取得了最佳结果,使CUHK-Pedes从47.6/57.0被改进为49.6/58.4和RSTPReID在mAP/R1中从25.8/36.6被改进为27.6/37.6. 虽然速度慢于不适应和TCR,但PRAISE仍然远快于TPT和WATT等增强重力方法,同时在不完整或模糊的文本查询下提供更强的检索精度. 与I2I-ReID类似,我们发现直接分数核聚变对整体取回具有正向作用,但因其校正不当而导致排名精度下降.

blocks.en: Component Ablations. Using ACS only as a frozen score gives little improvement over the base model, while adaptation without ACS provides only modest gains. In contrast, combining query-side adaptation with ACS improves Market-1501 from 35.0/62.6 to 46.5/71.1 mAP/R1 and RSTPReID from 23.1/34.5 to 27.6/37.6. Thus, ACS is not effective as a standalone re-ranking signal; its main benefit arises from guiding the adaptation process with query-conditioned semantic geometry.
blocks.zh: 组件偏差。 使用ACS只作为被冻结的分数,对基准模型没有什么改进,而没有ACS的适应只能提供微小的收益. 相比之下,将查询面适应与ACS相结合,市场1501从35.0/62.6到46.5/71.1 mAP/R1和RSTPReID从23.1/34.5到27.6/37.6. 因此,ACS作为一个独立的再排位信号并不有效;其主要好处来自以查询条件的语义几何来指导适应过程.

blocks.en: Subspace and Score-Fusion Ablations. Shuffling prompts, using a constant ACS, or replacing ACS with a random subspace substantially degrades performance, confirming the importance of both semantic grounding and query conditioning. Removing QR while keeping the same selected directions also reduces performance to 44.2/68.1 on Market-1501 and 26.4/36.8 on RSTPReID, showing that orthogonalization is beneficial. Motivated by a denoising interpretation, we further compare matched-rank PCA subspaces from the prompt bank and gallery features. Both are competitive in mAP, reaching 45.3/63.0 and 45.2/62.9 on Market-1501, but remain below ACS, especially in Rank-1 accuracy, with the same ordering on RSTPReID. Thus, low-rank projection itself is useful, while query-conditioned semantic selection better resolves top-ranked matches. Stronger score-fusion baselines show a similar trend. Standardized and temperature-calibrated fusion improve over direct fusion, but the best variant reaches only 41.5/61.8 and 25.1/33.9, remaining clearly below PRAISE .
blocks.zh: 子空间与分数相通. shuffling protes,使用恒定ACS,或用随机子空间来取代ACS会大幅度地降解性能,确认了语义地平和查询条件的重要性. 在保留相同的选定方向的同时去除QR也会将市场-1501的性能降低到44.2/68.1,RSTPReID的性能降低到26.4/36.8,表明正交化是有益的. 在解密解释的推动下,我们进一步比较了与速成银行和画廊特征相匹配的PCA子空间。 两者在mAP中都具有竞争力,在Market-1501上达到45.3/63.0和45.2/62.9,但仍低于ACS,特别是在Rank-1精度方面,同样在RSTPReID上订购. 因此,低等投影本身是有用的,而以查询为条件的语义选择则能更好地解决排名最高的匹配. 更强的得分组合基线也呈现出类似趋势. 标准化和温度校正聚变比直接聚变要好,但最好的变体只达到41.5/61.8和25.1/33.9,明显低于PRAISE。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Limitations. PRAISE uses a fixed standardized attribute bank, so its effectiveness depends on the coverage of the prompt vocabulary and may be limited for rare or highly fine-grained appearance cues. Furthermore, when the initial VLM representation is very weak or the query is severely occluded/noisy, the selected attribute directions may be unreliable, limiting the benefit of ACS. This has been analyzed and reported in the Supplementary Materials.
blocks.zh: 限制。 PRAISE使用一个固定的标准化属性库,因此其有效性取决于即时词汇的涵盖范围,对于稀有或高度精细的外观提示可能受到限制. 此外,当最初的VLM代表非常薄弱或查询被严重占用/噪音时,选定的属性方向可能不可靠,限制了ACS的好处. 补充材料对此进行了分析和报告。

blocks.en: We introduced PRAISE , a label-free TTA framework for VLM-based ReID across I2I and T2I retrieval. Our results show that attribute prompts are unreliable as direct matching scores, but become effective when used as query-conditioned directions for guiding retrieval adaptation. This provides a lightweight way to inject attribute consistency at test time without identity or attribute labels. Future work will explore query-adaptive prompt banks to improve coverage beyond a fixed bank of pedestrian attributes.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PRAISE,一个无标签的TTA框架,用于通过I2I和T2I检索基于VLM的ReID. 我们的结果表明,属性提示作为直接匹配分数是不可靠的,但当用作指导检索调整的有查询条件的方向时,它就会生效. 这提供了一种轻量级的方法,在测试时注入属性一致性,没有身份或属性标签. 未来工作将探索适应查询的快速银行,以扩大覆盖范围,超越固定行人属性库.

blocks.en: We begin this section with a key observation in our loss function (Eq. 7, Main manuscript), that the loss essentially is a minimization of cosine distance within top-k gallery neighbours. Critically, most common TTA methods employ a direct feature level entropy [ wang2020tent , 28 , 36 ] . We first consider an empirical analysis to observe trends in retrieval error rate versus (1) cosine distance and (2) feature entropy. Thereafter, we use these findings to develop a theoretical explanation for why direct entropy is ill-posed as a potential retrieval uncertainty surrogate, and an alternative loss function that is suitable for ReID.
blocks.zh: 我们以损失功能(Eq. 7,主手稿)为开头的这一节主要观察,即损失基本上是将上行道邻居的余弦相距最小化。 关键是,最常用的TTA方法采用直接地物级 en [wang2020tent., 28., 36]. 我们首先考虑进行实证分析,以观察检索出错率相对于 (1) 余弦相距和 (2) 特征等效率的趋势. 之后,我们利用这些调查结果,对直接的 en作为潜在的检索不确定性替代物,以及适合ReID的替代损失功能,如何被错误地置入理论解释.

blocks.en: B.1 Empirical evidence: why feature-level entropy is a weak proxy for ReID uncertainty
blocks.zh: B.1 经验证据:为什么地物级 en是ReID不确定性的弱代名词.

blocks.en: We report two diagnostic curves ( Figure 5 ) that relate the test error rate to two candidate “confidence” signals computed from the frozen retrieval model: (i) the cosine distance of the top-1 match between query and gallery , and (ii) the feature level entropy of a prediction distribution. The distance plot exhibits a clear, smooth, and largely monotonic trend: as the top-1 cosine distance increases, the error rate increases substantially. This behavior is consistent with the ReID geometry, i.e. when the closest gallery point is far in the embedding space, the query is less likely to have a correct nearest neighbor. In contrast, the entropy plot shows a noisier and partially non-monotonic relationship. In particular, there exist regimes where entropy is relatively low but the error rate is high, and also regimes where entropy grows without a predictable change in error. This implies that direct feature level entropy is miscalibrated as an uncertainty indicator for ReID.

blocks.en: Entropy minimization implicitly encourages peaky predictions. In ReID test-time evaluation, identities are disjoint from training, and the correct notion of confidence is whether the query embedding is near its true neighbor(s) in 𝐙 g \mathbf{Z}_{g} , not whether it yields a confident classification under some surrogate label space. Concretely, entropy is typically defined over a distribution formed with respect to a classifier head trained on source identities. In case of ReID/Retrieval, the peaky predictions can occur for the wrong reasons . For example, a model can become highly confident in a direction that is unrelated to the correct gallery neighborhood, yielding low entropy but high error. This matches the empirical curve where low entropy does not guarantee low error.
blocks.zh: 将Entropy最小化隐含地鼓励了峰值的预测. 在ReID测试-时间评价中,身份与训练脱节,正确的置信概念是查询嵌入是否接近其Zg\mathbf{Z}_{g}中的真实邻居,而不是它是否在某些代名词标签空间下产生自信的分类. 具体地说, en的定义一般是针对接受过源身份培训的分类头而形成的分布. 在ReID/检索中,峰值预测可能因错误的原因发生. 例如,一个模型可以在一个与正确的画廊相邻区域无关的方向上变得高度自信,产生出低等但高出错. 这与低 en不能保证低出错的经验曲线相匹配.

blocks.en: Therefore, directly minimizing feature-level entropy is risky in ReID because it can over-emphasize “peakedness” (confidence) rather than neighborhood correctness . Under domain shift, this may accelerate drift toward spurious modes (overconfident wrong matches), which is exactly the kind of collapse we aim to avoid in test-time adaptation.
blocks.zh: 因此,在ReID中,直接将地物级同位素降到最低是危险的,因为它可以过分强调“高峰”(自信)而不是邻里正确性。 在域位转移下,这可能会加速向假模式(过度自信的错配)的漂移,这正是我们力求在测试时间适应时避免的崩溃类型.

blocks.en:
This section describes the construction of the attribute prompt bank used by PRAISE .
The overall pipeline is shown in Figure 7 . Given a set of unlabeled pedestrian images, we first use a vision-language model to extract compact appearance descriptions, then group the extracted cues into predefined pedestrian attribute categories, clean duplicate or noisy phrases, and finally insert the resulting attribute suffixes into a shared prompt template. Importantly, the procedure does not use identity labels, attribute annotations for any kind of target-domain supervision. The resulting bank is a fixed transferable vocabulary of pedestrian appearance cues, which is encoded once and reused by PRAISE during test-time adaptation.

本节介绍PRAISE所使用的属性快取库的构造.

blocks.en: We use Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 47 ] to extract short, visually grounded pedestrian attributes from each sampled image. The instruction asks the model to ignore background, pose, action, camera information, brand names, and identity-specific information, and to return only compact appearance attributes. The output is constrained to a JSON-like schema so that the extracted cues can be parsed automatically and aggregated across the dataset.

blocks.en: D.4 Vocabulary cleaning and de-duplication
blocks.zh: D.4 词汇清理和去除重复

blocks.en: The raw VLM outputs contain synonymous, near-duplicate, and occasionally noisy phrases. We therefore normalize each extracted value before adding it to the vocabulary. The cleaning stage lowercases all strings, removes punctuation and filler words, discards unknown or non-visible values, and merges common synonyms. For example, grey is canonicalized to gray , trousers to pants , and back pack to backpack . Long phrases are discarded because they usually indicate caption spillover rather than atomic attributes.

blocks.en: D.6 Prompt-bank construction and implementation details
blocks.zh: D.6 快速银行建设和执行细节

blocks.en: We construct the attribute-prompt bank once as an offline preprocessing step using Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. For each ReID dataset, attributes are mined exclusively from its training-image partition; test queries and gallery images are never used for prompt-bank construction. For Market-1501, we sample at most four training images per identity and cap the total mining set at 3,000 images. Sampling is performed with a fixed random seed of 0 0 . Training-set identity identifiers are used only to obtain approximately balanced image sampling across identities; identity labels are never provided to the VLM, do not determine the extracted vocabulary, and are not used during PRAISE test-time adaptation. Unless otherwise stated, junk/background identities are excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct构建属性即时库一次作为离线预处理步骤. 对于每个ReID数据集,属性完全从其训练-图像分区中挖掘出;测试查询和相册图像从未用于即时银行建设. 对于Market-1501来说,我们以每个身份最多4个培训图像进行抽样,并将采矿总量限制在3 000个图像。 取样使用固定的零分随机种子进行。 培训设定的身份识别器仅用于获取各种身份的大致平衡的图像取样;身份标签从未提供给VLM,没有确定所提取的词汇,也没有在PRAISE测试-时间适应时使用. 除非另有说明,垃圾/背景身份不包括在内。

blocks.en: Images are processed independently with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct in evaluation mode using bfloat16 precision on a single GPU. Generation is deterministic with a maximum of 192 newly generated tokens per image. The VLM is instructed to return only a JSON object containing short, visually observable pedestrian attributes and to output unknown when an attribute is not reliably visible. We explicitly prohibit descriptions of background, pose, action, camera, identity, brands, or image quality. By default, the mined vocabulary covers eight person-centric categories: upper-body color, upper-body clothing type, lower-body color, lower-body clothing type, shoes, bags, accessories, and hair. We do not include the optional age or gender categories in the experiments reported in this work.
blocks.zh: 图像在评价模式下使用Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct进行独立处理,在单个GPU上使用bfloat16精度. 生成是决定性的,每个图像最多有192个新生成的代号. VLM被指示只返回包含短而可视行人属性的JSON对象,当属性不可靠可见时输出未知. 我们明确禁止描述背景、姿势、动作、相机、身份、品牌或图像质量。 默认情况下,被开采的词汇涵盖了以人为中心的8个类别:上体颜色,上体服装类型,下体颜色,下体服装类型,鞋子,包,配件,和发型. 我们没有将可选年龄或性别类别纳入这项工作中报告的实验。

blocks.en: The raw VLM outputs are parsed and canonicalized before constructing the bank. Values marked as unknown/unclear are discarded, textual variants are normalized, common color and clothing synonyms are merged, and excessively long attribute phrases are removed. We retain an attribute only if it occurs in at least five mined images and retain at most 40 attributes per category. Duplicate prompts are subsequently removed. Each surviving attribute is converted into a category-specific natural-language template; for example, an upper-body color is expressed as “A photo of a person wearing a {attribute} upper-body garment,” while a bag attribute uses “A photo of a person carrying {attribute}.” The resulting bank contains L = 57 L=\textbf{57} unique prompts for Market-1501. The complete vocabulary and occurrence counts are provided in the released prompt-bank files.
blocks.zh: 原始的VLM输出在建库前被解析并被卡通. 被标记为未知/不明的值被丢弃,文本变体被正常化,常见的颜色和服装同义词被合并,过度长的属性短语被去掉. 我们只保留一个属性,条件是它至少出现在五个被埋设的图像中,并且每个类别保留最多40个属性。 复制提示随后被删除. 每个幸存的属性被转换成一个特定类别的自然语言模板;例如,上体颜色被表示为“穿{属性}上体服装的人的照片”,而袋属性使用“携带{属性}的人的照片”。 由此形成的银行包含有: L = 57 L=\textbf{57} 市场-1501的独有提示. 完整的词汇和发生数在已发布的即时银行文件中提供.

blocks.en: For Market-1501, we sample up to four training images per identity, with a maximum of 3,000 images used for prompt mining. Attributes are retained only if they are observed in at least five sampled images, and the vocabulary is capped at 40 attributes per semantic category. All sampling is performed with a fixed random seed of 0. The complete mining procedure requires approximately 102 minutes ( 12 minutes for loading model shards and  90 minutes for analyzing 3000 images from the training dataset) on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU . This cost is incurred only once when constructing the reusable semantic vocabulary and is therefore reported separately from online PRAISE inference. Once constructed, the prompt bank is stored and reused for all subsequent queries; prompt embeddings are likewise precomputed before test-time adaptation. Additional experiments in subsection E.2 show that banks mined from a different source dataset remain effective, indicating that PRAISE does not rely on a dataset-specific prompt vocabulary.

blocks.en: Under additive noise, the dominant failure mode is often feature dispersion (reduced similarity gaps) rather than semantic misalignment. Entropy-based adaptation methods can then act as effective confidence restorers : by sharpening the retrieval posterior they partially recover top-neighbor separation, which explains their improved mAP/R1 under Gaussian and Poisson noise compared to their clean-domain behavior. This is especially visible for SAR, ETA and DeYO, which surpass or match the no-adapt baseline under both noise types (e.g., DeYO reaches 27.4 / 54.0 27.4/54.0 on Gaussian and 18.2 / 41.8 18.2/41.8 on Poisson, while the baseline is 24.2 / 50.7 24.2/50.7 and 14.5 / 37.5 14.5/37.5 ). In other words, when corruptions are mostly non-semantic and approximately independent and identically distributed, entropy filtering tends to select “still-recoverable” queries, and sharpening helps re-separate nearest neighbors.
blocks.zh: 在添加性噪声下,主要的故障模式往往是特征分散(减少相似性差距),而不是语义错配. 以Entropy为基础的适应方法可以起到有效的信心恢复器的作用:通过更敏锐地进行后取回,它们部分地恢复了上-邻分离,这解释了它们在高斯和波森噪声下经过改进的mAP/R1与其清洁领域的行为相比. 对合成孔径雷达、ETA和DeYO来说,这一点尤其明显,它们超过了或符合两种噪声类型的不适应基线(例如:高斯语的DeYO达到27.4/54.0 27.4/54.0;波森语的为18.2/41.8;而基线为24.2/50.7 24.2/50.7和14.5/37.5 14.5/37.5)。 换句话说,当腐败大多是非语义性的,而且几乎是独立和完全相同的分布时,肽过滤往往会选择“仍然可以恢复的”查询,而磨损有助于将最近的邻居重新隔离。

blocks.en: Some methods exhibit extreme behavior under specific corruptions (e.g., SHOT collapses under Motion Blur with 1.9 / 4.9 1.9/4.9 ). This is plausible because motion blur introduces strong, structured high-frequency attenuation and spatial streaking, which can systematically break pseudo-label/consistency assumptions and thus updates can become dominated by incorrect neighbors, leading to rapid confirmation-bias collapse. Conversely, methods can appear unusually strong under noise because the corruption perturbs features in a way that preserves coarse identity structure and the TTA objective can then effectively “denoise” the retrieval posterior by amplifying pre-existing similarity gaps.
blocks.zh: 一些方法在具体腐败下表现出了极端的行为(例如,运动模糊下SHOT倒塌,1.9/4.9 1.9/4.9)。 这样做是合理的,因为运动模糊性引入了强而有条理的高频衰减和空间螺纹,这可以系统地打破伪标签/一致性假设,从而更新可以被不正确的邻居所主导,导致快速确认-比斯倒塌. 反之,在噪音下,方法可能显得异常强大,因为腐败的特点是保持了粗糙的身份结构和TTA目标,从而能够通过扩大原有的相似性差距而有效地“暴露”回收后的作用。

blocks.en: For Defocus Blur, Motion Blur, and Brightness, the ordering becomes more consistent with the main paper: generic entropy-minimization baselines provide only modest gains (or can degrade), while retrieval-aligned objectives are more reliable. Notably, PRAISE improves substantially on the harder structured corruptions (e.g., Defocus Blur 23.9 / 41.8 23.9/41.8 and Motion Blur 15.7 / 33.4 15.7/33.4 ), where naive sharpening is more likely to overfit to spurious top-1 matches. This is consistent with the view that blur/illumination changes induce more semantics-affecting shifts (texture suppression, edge degradation, global intensity shifts) that demand retrieval-specific inductive biases, making the robustness trends closer to those observed in the evaluations of the main manuscript.
blocks.zh: 对于去焦点模糊,运动模糊,和亮度,定单与正文更加一致:通用的 en-最小化基线只提供微小的增益(或可以降解),而回取相通的目标更可靠. 值得注意的是,PRAISE大大改进了结构更复杂的腐败(例如,Decusion Blur 23.9 / 41.8 23.9/41.8和Motion Blur 15.7 / 33.4 15.7/33.4),在这些腐败中,天真地磨合更可能与假的顶一相配。 这符合一种观点,即模糊/光照变化会导致更多的语义影响变化(纹理抑制、边缘退化、全球强度变化),从而需要针对检索的诱导偏差,从而使强势趋势更接近于主要手稿评价中观察到的趋势。

blocks.en: E.2 Attribute bank Source and Category Ablations
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 属性库 来源和类别

blocks.en: Table 6 : Effect of attribute prompt-bank source. We evaluate PRAISE using the same fixed hyperparameters while varying only the source used to construct the attribute prompt bank. The manual bank is hand-designed, while the remaining banks are mined from the corresponding ReID datasets using the same label-free captioning and cleaning protocol. Results show that PRAISE is not tied to a specific prompt-bank source and remains stable across transferable pedestrian attribute vocabularies.
blocks.zh: 表6:属性即时银行来源的影响。 我们使用相同的固定超参数来评估PRAISE,而只改变用于构建属性快取库的源. 手动库采用手动设计,而剩余库则取自相应的ReID数据集,使用相同的无标签字幕和清洁协议. 结果显示,PRAISE没有与特定的即时银行来源挂钩,在可转移行人属性词汇表之间保持稳定.

blocks.en: Impact of attribute source. Table 6 studies whether the performance of PRAISE depends on the dataset used to construct the attribute prompt bank. Across all four benchmarks, replacing the default Market-1501 mined bank with manually designed prompts or banks mined from MSMT17, CUHK-PEDES, and RSTP-ReID leads to only small performance changes. All prompt banks consistently improve over the no-adapt source model, indicating that the gains of PRAISE do not come from a dataset-specific vocabulary or from overfitting the prompt bank to a particular benchmark. We observe a slight advantage for prompt banks mined from I2I-ReID datasets, especially Market-1501 and MSMT17. This is likely because these datasets contain surveillance-style pedestrian crops collected across multiple cameras, viewpoints, poses, and illumination conditions, which closely matches the visual gallery distribution used during ReID retrieval. As a result, the mined attributes tend to capture common visually grounded pedestrian cues, such as clothing color, clothing type, bags, shoes, and hair, that transfer well across both I2I and T2I settings. In contrast, banks mined from T2I-ReID datasets remain competitive but can reflect the visual and linguistic biases of text-person-search datasets, where some cues may be more description-oriented or less diverse in surveillance appearance. Nevertheless, the small variation across rows shows that PRAISE is robust to the prompt-bank source and only requires a transferable pedestrian attribute vocabulary rather than a dataset-specific prompt set.
blocks.zh: 属性源的影响. 表6研究PRAISE的性能是否取决于用于构建属性快取库的数据集. 在所有四项基准中,用MSMT17、CUHK-PEDES和RSTP-ReID等手动设计的提示来取代默认的Market-1501布雷库,只导致小的性能变化。 所有快取银行在不适应源模型上都不断改进,表明PRAISE的收益并非来自数据集特定词汇或从快取银行过度匹配到特定基准. 我们发现,从I2I-ReID数据集,特别是Market-1501和MSMT17所开采的即时银行有一个微小的优势。 这可能是因为这些数据集包含跨越多个相机收集的监视式行人作物,视角,姿势和发光条件,这与ReID检索时使用的可视画廊分布非常相匹配. 因此,被埋设的属性往往能捕捉常见的视网膜行人提示,如服装颜色、服装类型、包、鞋和发型,这些提示在I2I和T2I两种设置之间都传递得很好。 相比之下,从T2I-ReID数据集中挖掘出来的银行仍然具有竞争力,但能够反映文本人搜索数据集的视觉和语言偏差,其中一些提示在监视外观上可能更注重描述或少有差异. 尽管如此,跨行的细微变化表明PRAISE对快取银行源很强,只需要一个可转移行人属性词汇,而不是数据集专用的快取集.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Attribute-category ablation. We evaluate PRAISE using the same Market-1501 mined prompt bank and fixed hyperparameters, while removing one group of attributes at a time. This isolates which attribute categories contribute most to the query-conditioned ACS geometry.
blocks.zh: 表7:属性类扩展。 我们使用同一市场1501号矿床和固定高参数评估PRAISE,同时一次去除一组属性。 此隔离属性类最有助于查询条件的ACS几何.

blocks.en: Impact of attribute categories. Table 7 studies the contribution of different attribute groups by removing one category at a time from the Market-1501 mined prompt bank. All ablated variants remain well above the no-adapt source model, showing that PRAISE does not depend on a single attribute type and instead benefits from a redundant set of complementary pedestrian cues. Among the categories, upper-body color and bag/accessory prompts have the largest effect: removing upper-body color reduces performance on both Market-1501 and RSTP-ReID, while removing bag/accessory prompts produces one of the strongest drops, especially on RSTP-ReID. This is consistent with standard ReID behavior, where upper clothing color is often the most visible short-term identity cue, and carried objects or accessories provide discriminative evidence when present. In contrast, removing hair has negligible effect, suggesting that hair cues are either less reliably visible or already captured indirectly by other appearance prompts. Importantly, removing age or gender does not degrade performance and in some cases slightly improves it, indicating that PRAISE does not rely on demographic-like attributes. This supports the use of a safer prompt bank focused primarily on clothing, color, and carried-object cues in applications surrounding sensitive private information.
blocks.zh: 属性类别的影响。 表7研究了不同属性群体的贡献,一次将一个类别从市场1501所开采的快取出。 所有被淡化的变体仍然远远地高于不适应的源模型,表明PRAISE并不依赖于单一的属性类型,而是受益于一组多余的补充行人提示. 在这些类别中,上体色和袋/接取快递具有最大的效果:去掉上体色会降低市场-1501和RSTP-ReID的性能,而去掉袋/接取快递则会产生最强的滴出,特别是在RSTP-ReID上. 这符合标准的ReID行为,即上衣颜色往往是最能见度的短期身份提示,所携带的物体或附件在出现时提供歧视性证据. 相形之下,去除发型的效果可以忽略不计,说明发型提示要么不可靠地可见,要么已经被其他外观提示所间接捕捉. 重要的是,消除年龄或性别不会降低业绩,在某些情况下略有改善,表明PRAISE不依赖人口特征。 这支持在围绕敏感私人信息的应用程序中使用一个主要侧重于服装、颜色和携带物体提示的更安全的快速银行。

blocks.en: E.3 Extended Performance on CLIP-ReID [ 26 ] and RDE [ qin2024noisy ]
blocks.zh: E.3. CLIP-ReID[26]和RDE[qin2024noisy]的扩展性能

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. The absolute no-adapt scores in Table 8 and Table 9 should not be interpreted as reproduced numbers from the original papers. Our goal is to evaluate test-time adaptation under a common retrieval interface that is compatible with PRAISE . Specifically, PRAISE requires query, gallery, and text-prompt representations to lie in the same VLM embedding space so that prompt-induced directions can be used to construct ACS. We therefore use the CLIP image embedding with cosine similarity for retrieval, without the task-specific ReID head used in the original supervised evaluation. This changes the absolute no-adapt performance relative to the original paper, but it is applied uniformly to all methods in the table. Thus, the comparison measures how each TTA method modifies the same fixed-gallery cosine retrieval geometry, rather than comparing against separately optimized task-specific heads.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 表8和表9中绝对不适应的分数不应被解释为原论文所转载的数字。 我们的目标是在与PRAISE兼容的共同检索界面下评价测试时间适应性。 具体地说,PRAISE需要查询,画廊,和文本即时表示,才能躺在同一个VLM嵌入空间中,以便能使用即时引发的方向来构建ACS. 因此,我们使用嵌入相弦相近的 CLIP 图像进行检索,而不使用原监督评价中使用的任务特定ReID头. 这改变了相对于原始纸张的绝对不适应性能,但它被统一应用于表中的所有方法. 因此,比较方法衡量每种TTA方法如何修改同一种固定加热余弦回取几何,而不是与单独优化的任务特定头相比较.

blocks.en: Table 8 : Comparison of TTA methods on I2I-ReID benchmarks using a source-trained CLIP-ReID [ 26 ] image encoder. All methods are evaluated under the same PRAISE-compatible cosine-retrieval protocol, with fixed gallery embeddings and no target identity labels.
blocks.zh: 表8:使用源训练的CLIP-ReID[26]图像编码器比较I2I-ReID基准上的TTA方法. 所有方法都在同一PRAISE相容的余弦-检索协议下进行评估,有固定的画廊嵌入,没有目标身份标签.

blocks.en: How does PRAISE perform on CLIP-ReID [ 26 ] backbone. Table 8 evaluates PRAISE in a more strongly supervised setting using a source-trained CLIP-ReID backbone. Since the backbone has already been trained for identity discrimination, the source model provides a much stronger retrieval geometry than the generic PLIP setting, leaving less room for test-time adaptation. Under this setting, several generic TTA objectives degrade performance, especially TENT, SHOT, SAR, ETA, and DeYO. This behavior is expected in open-set ReID: entropy-style sharpening can reinforce the model’s current nearest-neighbor structure, which may already be highly confident but still biased by camera, pose, or dataset-specific appearance correlations. As a result, directly sharpening the retrieval distribution can over-concentrate probability mass around visually similar distractors rather than improving identity ranking. In contrast, PRAISE consistently improves the source-trained CLIP-ReID model across both source and cross-dataset evaluations. The gains are moderate compared to the generic-backbone setting, but this is expected because the supervised backbone already produces strong identity features. Importantly, PRAISE improves both source-domain performance and cross-dataset transfer, indicating that the ACS-guided adaptation does not simply compensate for a weak backbone. Instead, the attribute-conditioned subspace provides complementary semantic structure that can refine an already discriminative ReID embedding. Norm remains a strong post-hoc baseline and achieves the best Rank-1 in one cross-dataset case, but PRAISE obtains the best mAP in all settings and the best or second-best Rank-1 across the table. These results show that PRAISE remains useful even when applied on top of a competitive source-trained ReID backbone, addressing the concern that the improvements are specific to weaker or generic VLM representations.
blocks.zh: PRAISE在CLIP-ReID[26]骨干上的表现如何. 表8利用经源头培训的CLIP-ReID主干线,在更严格的监督下评价PRAISE。 由于骨干已经接受了身份歧视的培训,源模型提供的检索几何学比通用的PLIP设置要强得多,为测试时间适应留下了较少的空间. 在此情况下,若干一般性的TTA目标降低了性能,特别是TENT、SHOT、SAR、ETA和DeYO。 这种行为在开放设置ReID中是预期的: en式的磨合可以强化模型当前最近的邻接结构,这种结构可能已经非常自信,但仍被相机,姿势,或数据集特有的外观关联所偏向. 因此,直接收缩回取分布可以将概率质量过度集中到视觉相近的分光器周围,而不是改善身份排名. 相比之下,PRAISE在源头和跨数据集评价中不断改进经源头培训的CLIP-ReID模型。 与通用后骨设置相比,收益是中等的,但预计这是因为受监督的骨干已经产生了很强的特征. 重要的是,PRAISE既改进了源域性能,又改进了跨数据集传输,表明ACS制导的适应并不仅仅弥补了薄弱的骨干. 相反,属性条件的子空间提供了互补的语义结构,可以完善已经具有歧视性的ReID嵌入. Norm仍然是一个强力的Hoc后基线,并在一个跨数据集的案例中达到最佳的Rank-1,但PRAISE在所有场合都获得最佳的mAP,并在表上获得最佳或二等的Rank-1. 这些结果表明,即便在具有竞争力的经源培训的ReID主干线上应用,PRAISE仍然有用,解决了改进是针对较弱或通用的VLM表示的担忧。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Comparison of TTA methods on T2I-ReID benchmarks using source-trained RDE [ qin2024noisy ] backbones. All methods are evaluated under the same PRAISE-compatible cosine-retrieval protocol, with fixed gallery embeddings and no target identity labels.
blocks.zh: 表9:使用源培训的RDE [qin2024noisy]主干线对T2I-ReID基准的TTA方法进行比较. 所有方法都在同一PRAISE相容的余弦-检索协议下进行评估,有固定的画廊嵌入,没有目标身份标签.

blocks.en: How does PRAISE perform on RDE [ qin2024noisy ] backbone. Table 9 evaluates PRAISE on source-trained RDE backbones under both source-domain and cross-dataset T2I-ReID settings. Compared with the PLIP setting in the main paper, the no-adapt RDE model already provides a much stronger retrieval representation, so the available room for test-time adaptation is smaller. This is reflected in the relatively mild gains of most generic TTA methods, and in several cases their performance degradation. In particular, classification-oriented or generic VLM adaptation methods are not necessarily aligned with the fixed-gallery ranking objective of T2I-ReID, and their sharpening or prompt-adaptation objectives can disrupt an already discriminative retrieval embedding.
blocks.zh: PRAISE如何在RDE [qin2024noisy]骨干上表现. 表9评价了源域和跨数据集T2I-ReID设置下经源培训的RDE主干线的PRAISE. 相较于正文中的PLIP设置,不适应的RDE模型已经提供了更强得多的回取表现,因此可用的测试时间适应空间较小. 这一点反映在大多数通用的TTA方法的相对温和收益上,以及在某些情况下其性能退化上. 特别是,面向分类的或通用的VLM适应方法不一定符合T2I-ReID的固定采集分级目标,而其锐化或即时调整的目标会打乱已经存在歧视性的检索嵌入.

blocks.en: Among prior methods, [ 22 ] is the strongest baseline and achieves the second-best result across all evaluated metrics. Nevertheless, PRAISE consistently improves over both the no-adapt RDE model and all TTA baselines. The gains are moderate on source-domain evaluation, where the supervised RDE representation is already well calibrated, and larger under cross-dataset transfer, where query-gallery alignment is more affected by dataset shift. This shows that ACS-guided adaptation is not limited to weak or generic VLM backbones; it remains complementary to a source-trained T2I-ReID model by refining the retrieval geometry using query-conditioned attribute directions.
blocks.zh: 在以前的方法中,[22]是最强的基准,在所有评估的衡量尺度中都取得了第二好的结果。 尽管如此,PRAISE在不适应RDE模型和所有TTA基线上都不断改进. 这些收益在源域评价方面是适度的,在源域评价方面,受监督的RDE代表已经进行了良好的校正,在跨数据集传输方面,查询-采集对接受到数据集转移的影响更大。 这表明ACS制导的适应并不限于薄弱或通用的VLM主干线;它仍然通过使用查询条件属性方向来精炼回取几何,对源训练的T2I-ReID模型起到补充作用.

blocks.en: E.4 Gallery-size scalability
blocks.zh: E.4 图片库大小可缩放性

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Gallery-size scalability of PRAISE on MSMT17 with PLIP. Peak GPU-memory and adaptation-latency increases are reported relative to the 1k-gallery setting. The gallery is increased from 1,000 to the full 82,161 images while retaining the default adaptation batch size of 32. Even at the full gallery, peak memory increases by only 9.0 % 9.0\% , while amortized per-query latency increases by 15.5 % 15.5\% .
blocks.zh: 图8:PRAISE在MSMT17上与PLIP的图片库大小可扩展性. 据报道,相对于1k-gallery的设定,峰值GPU-memory和适应-适切性都有所增加. 画廊从1000幅增加到了完整的82,161幅图像,同时保留了32幅的默认适应分批大小. 即使在整个画廊,峰值内存只增加9.0% 9.0\%,而分期摊还的每平时的活度也增加15.5% 15.5\%.

blocks.en: To evaluate the scalability of PRAISE with respect to gallery size, we conduct an additional experiment on MSMT17 using the PLIP backbone. MSMT17 is particularly suitable for this analysis because its large gallery allows us to evaluate PRAISE over a substantially wider range of gallery sizes than the other benchmarks. We progressively increase the gallery from 1,000 images to the full 82,161 images while keeping the adaptation configuration fixed, including the default query batch size of 32.
blocks.zh: 为了评估PRAISE在画廊规模方面的可扩展性,我们利用PLIP主干线对MSMT17进行了额外的实验. MSMT17特别适合这一分析,因为它的大型画廊使我们能够对PRAISE进行比其他基准大得多的画廊规模的评价. 我们逐渐将画廊从1000个图像增加到82,161个完整的图像,同时保持适应配置的固定,包括32个默认的查询批量大小.

blocks.en: Figure 8 reports the relative increase in peak GPU memory and adaptation latency with respect to the 1k-gallery setting. We normalize both quantities to their respective values at 1,000 gallery images to make their scaling behavior directly comparable despite having different physical units. Peak GPU memory increases only modestly as the gallery grows: from 4,179 MB at 1k images to 4,555 MB for the complete 82,161-image gallery, corresponding to an increase of approximately 9.0 % 9.0\% . Runtime exhibits similarly gradual scaling. The measured adaptation throughput decreases from 3.95 to 3.42 batches/s between the 1k and full-gallery settings. Since each adaptation iteration processes a batch of 32 queries, this corresponds to an increase in amortized latency from approximately 7.91 to 9.14 ms/query, or 15.5 % 15.5\% .
blocks.zh: 图8报告了与1k-gallery设置有关的峰值GPU内存和适应延迟的相对增加. 尽管物理单位不同,我们还是将两者的数量与1000个画廊图像的数值相匹配,使其缩放行为直接具有可比性。 峰值GPU内存仅随着画廊的增大而适度地增加:从4,179 MB在1k图像上增加到4,555 MB在完整的82,161-图像画廊上,相当于约9.0% 9.0\%. 运行时间显示类似逐步缩放。 所测量的适应吞吐量从3.95个批次降至3.42个批次/次,介于1k和全电池设置之间。 由于每次适应迭代都会处理一批32个查询,这相当于摊还延迟率从7.91至9.14毫秒/克来,即15.5%至15.5%。

blocks.en: These results indicate that the gallery-dependent operations in PRAISE introduce relatively small additional memory and computational overhead even when the gallery size is increased by more than 80 × 80\times . Importantly, these measurements correspond only to online test-time adaptation and retrieval; one-time preprocessing operations such as gallery feature extraction and prompt-bank construction are reported separately and are not included in this scalability analysis.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,PRAISE中依赖画廊的操作引入了相对较小的额外内存和计算间接费用,即使画廊的大小增加了80×80\次以上. 重要的是,这些测量结果只对应在线测试时间的适应和检索;诸如画廊地物提取和即时银行建设等一次性预处理操作单独报告,不列入这种可缩放性分析.

blocks.en: E.5 Sensitivity to Initial Retrieval Quality
blocks.zh: E.5 对初始检索质量的敏感性

blocks.en: A potential failure mode of query-side adaptation is confirmation bias, where an incorrect initial neighborhood is reinforced during optimization. To study this effect, we stratify Market-1501 queries according to the initial rank of the first valid cross-camera match under the frozen PLIP baseline. We consider six groups: Rank-1, ranks 2–5, 6–10, 11–20, 21–50, and 51 + 51+ . For each group, we record whether PRAISE improves, preserves, or degrades the rank of the first correct match. We also report the change in reciprocal rank, Δ ​ RR = 1 r PRAISE − 1 r base , \Delta\mathrm{RR}=\frac{1}{r_{\mathrm{\text{{{PRAISE}}{}}}}}-\frac{1}{r_{\mathrm{\text{base}}}}, which emphasizes changes near the top of the retrieval list while reducing the influence of very large absolute rank changes.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 9 , PRAISE is not restricted to queries whose correct identity already appears in the initial retrieval head. Excluding queries that are already correct at Rank-1, a majority of queries improve in every initial-rank group. When the first correct match lies outside the initial top-5 neighborhood, PRAISE improves its rank for 63.4% of queries. Among these cases, 30.2% are moved into the final top-5 and 13.3% reach Rank-1. The median rank gain is six positions and the mean reciprocal-rank change is +0.164 . Positive mean Δ ​ RR \Delta\mathrm{RR} is observed across all non-Rank-1 groups.

blocks.en: For queries already correct at Rank-1, PRAISE preserves Rank-1 in 83.9% of cases. Since these queries cannot improve further in first-match rank, any change can only preserve or degrade their position. Overall, these results show that PRAISE does not simply reinforce candidates already present in the initial top- k k neighborhood and can recover a substantial fraction of initially poor retrievals. Degradation remains possible for unreliable neighborhoods, which we retain as a limitation of query-side test-time adaptation.
blocks.zh: 对于在Rank-1中已经正确的询问,PRAISE保留了83.9%的Rank-1. 由于这些查询在一局排名上无法进一步改进,任何更改只能保留或降低其位置. 总体而言,这些结果显示,PRAISE并不只是加强已经存在于最初的顶级-kk社区的候选人,而且可以恢复最初检索不足的很大一部分。 对不可靠的社区来说,退化仍然是可能的,我们保留了这种可能性,作为对查询-测试-时间适应的一种限制。

blocks.zh: E.6 对直接融合重量的敏感性

blocks.en: To assess whether the weakness of direct attribute-score fusion is caused by the choice of fusion weight, we sweep λ att \lambda_{\mathrm{att}} in Eq. (2) over { 0 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.5 , 1.0 } \{0,0.1,0.2,0.5,1.0\} . Here, λ att = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{att}}=0 corresponds to identity-only adaptation without attribute-score fusion. As shown in Table 10 , a small attribute contribution improves mAP, with λ att = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{att}}=0.1 reaching 39.2 on Market-1501 and 24.5 on RSTPReID. However, Rank-1 accuracy decreases from 65.0 to 60.3 and from 35.4 to 32.9, respectively. Increasing the fusion weight further degrades both metrics. Thus, direct attribute scores contain useful retrieval information, but no tested fusion weight consistently improves both mAP and Rank-1 over the identity-only setting. All settings also remain well below PRAISE, supporting the use of attributes as query-conditioned geometric guidance rather than as directly added retrieval scores.

blocks.en: E.7 Impact on camera bias
blocks.zh: E.7 联合国 对相机偏差的影响

blocks.en: Figure 10 : NMI comparison across methods.
blocks.zh: 图10:不同方法的NMI比较。

blocks.en: We want to assess whether our approach effectively mitigates camera bias. To measure this, we employ a mutual information (MI) based evaluation following the protocol suggested in [ 38 ] . The rationale behind this experiment is that, if feature representations exhibit reduced dependence on camera labels, the mutual information between features and camera identifiers should correspondingly decrease. Figure 10 presents the outcomes of this analysis. The results indicate that both Camera Normalization [ 38 ] and PRAISE achieve the lowest normalized mutual information (NMI) scores, suggesting a comparatively weaker association between features and camera labels. Camera Normalization proves to be more effective when it comes to dealing with camera bias. While these findings do not constitute definitive evidence for the complete elimination of camera bias, they provide strong empirical support that our approach substantially attenuates such bias in the learned feature representations.
blocks.zh: 我们想评估我们的方法是否有效地减轻相机偏差。 为了衡量这一点,我们根据[38]中所建议的议定书,采用基于相互信息的评估。 这一实验的理由是,如果特征表示显示对相机标签的依赖性降低,特征和相机识别器之间的相互信息应相应减少. 图10列出了这一分析的结果。 结果显示相机正常化[38]和PRAISE都实现了最低的常态互通信息分数(NMI),表明特征和相机标签之间的联系相对薄弱. 相机正常化被证明在处理相机偏差时更为有效. 虽然这些结论并不构成完全消除相机偏差的确凿证据,但它们提供了有力的经验支持,即我们的方法大大地减轻了在所学特征表述中的这种偏差。

blocks.en: Figure 11 presents qualitative I2I-ReID examples on Market-1501. In the success cases among the first five rows, the adapted rankings better prioritize the true identity by suppressing visually similar distractors. This is visible when the source model retrieves near-duplicates with mismatched clothing patterns or accessories, while the adapted predictions shift more correct matches into the top positions.
blocks.zh: 图11显示了市场1501的定性I2I-ReID实例。 在前五行的成功案例中,经过调整的排名通过压制视觉相近的分心器,更好地优先确定真实身份. 当源模型以不匹配的服装图案或附件来取取出相近的复制件时,这一点是可见的,而被调整后的预测则将更正确的匹配转换到顶部位置.

blocks.en: The failure cases suggest a characteristic failure mode of online adaptation with attribute guidance. When the initial attribute-driven affinity is incorrect, the subsequent sharpening can reinforce the wrong neighborhood and bias the update toward an incorrect set of gallery candidates. In (h) and (j), even though the query depicts a woman, the adapted retrieval settles on men with similar color cues. This is consistent with an erroneous early gender-related attribute estimate that redirects the ACS subspace toward spurious cues. Overall, the attribute directions are often beneficial, but they can occasionally sway retrieval by fixating on odd or weakly discriminative cues, leading to self-reinforced mistakes after adaptation.
blocks.zh: 故障案例表明具有属性指导的有特征的在线调整失败模式. 当初始属性驱动的亲和性不正确时,随后的磨合会强化错误的邻里,并使更新偏向于不正确的一组画廊候选人. 在(h)和(j)中,尽管查询中描绘的是一名妇女,但经过调整的检索仍以颜色相似的男子为准。 这与早期错误的与性别有关的属性估计是一致的,该估计将ACS子空间转向虚假的提示. 总体而言,属性方向往往有利可图,但偶尔可以通过固定于奇异或微弱的歧义提示来摇摆回取,导致适应后自我重复出错.

blocks.en: Figure 12 shows analogous behavior for T2I-ReID on RSTPReid. Some challenging queries remain correct after adaptation. In (c) and (d), the descriptions are visually ambiguous and still the adapted predictions maintain or improve the correct matches, indicating that ACS can help focus similarity on text-consistent visual evidence rather than incidental distractors. Failure cases for T2I arise when adaptation aggravates noisy correspondence between the text and the image set. In (f) and (i), the adapted rankings drift further from the correct identity, which is consistent with sharpening amplifying an initially misaligned top set. Compared to I2I, we observe that gender-related errors are better contained in T2I, likely because explicit textual descriptors provide a stronger constraint that reduces the chance of flipping into an incorrect gender-driven neighborhood.
blocks.zh: 图12显示了RSTPReid上的T2I-ReID的类似行为. 一些具有挑战性的询问在适应之后仍然是正确的。 在(c)和(d)中,描述在视觉上模棱两可,经过调整的预测仍然保持或改进了正确的匹配,表明ACS可以帮助将相似性集中在文本一致的视觉证据上,而不是偶然的分心器上. T2I的失败案例,因为适应加剧了文本和图像集之间的吵闹的对应. 在(f)和(一)中,经过调整的排名进一步偏离了正确的身份,这与强化最初错配的顶部组合是一致的。 与I2I相比,我们观察到与性别相关的错误在T2I中得到了更好的控制,这可能是因为清晰的文字描述提供了更强烈的制约,减少了翻入不正确的由性别驱动的街区的机会.

Only LayerNorm affine parameters in ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} (image encoder and gallery are fixed). • Pseudo-pairs. Use entropy of the B × B B\times B refined posterior as confidence (low entropy = stable pseudo-positive). • Constraints. Maintain a small queue of source-like items to estimate an adaptive entropy threshold and a target modality-gap statistic; optimize a weighted sum of noise-robust entropy, text-uniformity, and gap-matching terms.

blocks.en: Pseudo-pairs. Retrieve top gallery item per caption and gather corresponding image features to form an in-batch B × B B\times B “refined” similarity.
blocks.zh: 普修多菩萨. 每个标题检索顶端画廊项目并收集相应的图像特性,以形成相邻的 B × B B\times B “被改进的”相似性。

blocks.en: Reliability. Use entropy of the B × B B\times B refined posterior as confidence (low entropy = stable pseudo-positive).
blocks.zh: 可靠性。 将B×B B\times B精制后置的 en作为置信(低 en=稳定的伪阳性).

blocks.en: Constraints. Maintain a small queue of source-like items to estimate an adaptive entropy threshold and a target modality-gap statistic; optimize a weighted sum of noise-robust entropy, text-uniformity, and gap-matching terms.
blocks.zh: 制约因素。 保持一个小队的同源类项目,以估计适应性的同位素阈值和目标模式-差距统计;优化噪声-活性同位素、文本不一致和相通等词的加权和。

blocks.en: F.8 CLIPTTA-style TTA for T2I ReID (Contrastive with pseudo-positives)

blocks.en: • Idea. Build pseudo-positive image prototypes by retrieval and optimize a CLIP-style in-batch contrastive objective on caption–pseudoimage pairs. • What is tuned. Only normalization affine parameters in ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} (gallery and image encoder fixed). • Pseudo-positives. From S = z q ​ G ⊤ S=z_{q}G^{\top} , select top-1 or weighted top- k k gallery features per caption (stop-grad through selection). • Loss. Contrastive loss on the resulting B × B B\times B logits; fallback entropy-based objectives when B = 1 B=1 and optional transductive soft-target variants for stability. • Optional memory. FIFO queue of past pseudo-positives can be re-encoded under current ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} to stabilize updates across batches.
